About the school

A residential school with a clear sense of purpose.

Dodola Ifa Boru exists to help talented young people develop knowledge, discipline, character, and the confidence to contribute meaningfully.

Our story

Learning is stronger when the community is strong.

Dodola Ifa Boru Special Boarding School was established to provide an exceptional residential learning experience for high-achieving Grade 9–12 students. By bringing rigorous academic preparation together with a structured boarding environment, we cultivate curiosity, responsibility, and mutual respect among scholars from diverse backgrounds.

The school’s staff, wardens, families, and students share responsibility for creating a safe and ambitious environment where every learner is known and supported.

Our mission

Deliver high-caliber, holistic secondary education that empowers talented youth through academic mastery, technological literacy, personal responsibility, and leadership development.

Our vision

To stand as a premier educational beacon in Ethiopia and beyond, producing ethical, innovative leaders capable of solving complex global challenges.

How we work

Clear routines. High expectations. Real care.

Academic focus

Focused teaching and structured study time.

Safe residence

Wardens and staff who care for the whole student.

Shared responsibility

Students, families, and staff stay connected.
